purpose: Resolve whether current EntityOS authority supplies one exact executable EffectGate/EffectJournal implementation identity and a semantically complete request-binding contract that F2-WP-105 may use through CanonicalEffectAuthorityPort without creating a second effect authority.

coordination.review_only_reason: F2-WP-105 already has one active mutation authority; CLAIM_PROTOCOL permits independent review/falsification but forbids a second mutation authority.

current_authority_observation.manifest_legacy_clayverse_policy: HISTORICAL_DONOR_PROVENANCE_ONLY; not a current acceptance obligation unless explicitly re-admitted

candidate_surfaces.reason: Its own class documentation calls it a deterministic H1 reference gate; it does not provide the required EffectJournal/PENDING transition authority.

candidate_surfaces.contains: EffectGate execution donor with journal.begin before effect execution
candidate_surfaces.reason: Mechanically relevant, but current EntityOS manifest explicitly classifies ClayVerse as historical donor provenance unless explicitly re-admitted.

candidate_surfaces.contains: EffectJournal begin=PENDING, VERIFIED/DENIED/FAILED/STALE_OUTCOME/UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART terminal handling and no blind replay after restart
candidate_surfaces.reason: It matches the desired WP105 temporal semantics but shares the same non-readmitted ClayVerse donor boundary.

candidate_surfaces.contains: UnifiedDB donor schema including effects(effect_id,...,status,outcome,verified_at), causal_episodes and leases
candidate_surfaces.reason: Useful exact schema donor for adapter design; current authority does not bind it as the current executable EntityOS effect journal schema.

f2_bridge_observation.predispatch_identity_properties: Call identity is strongly bound across binding_id, invocation_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id and child identity; PENDING canonical effect_id is required before dispatch; executor exceptions stay UNKNOWN and are never blindly replayed.

semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.observation: EffectCallIntent contains correlation identity only: return_id, binding_id, invocation_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id and child_identity_sha256. CanonicalEffectAuthorityEvidence mirrors those correlation fields plus decision/journal/effect identity. Neither structure carries canonical effect semantics such as action, target, capability/effect_class, arguments, user/authority subject, or an immutable digest of that semantic request.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.candidate_gate_requirement: The current harness reference gate requires actor/action/target/effect_class and related authority facts; the historical executable donor requires user_id/session_id/capability/target/argv/generation. Therefore an adapter cannot derive a policy decision from EffectCallIntent alone without obtaining effect semantics from unbound out-of-band state or a closure.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.risk: An exact ALLOW can be correlated to call A while the authority evaluated semantic request B unless the semantic request is itself bound into both the authority decision and the exact executor invocation. Correlation identity alone does not prove semantic authorization identity.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.counterhypothesis: tool_use_id, invocation_id or child_identity_sha256 may indirectly identify an external record that already binds the complete effect request.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.counterhypothesis_status: NOT_PROVEN_BY_THE_REVIEWED_BRIDGE_OR_NATIVE_CHILD_BINDING_ABI; those types contain identifiers but no required semantic payload digest or resolver identity.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.falsifier: Produce an exact current source/receipt proving that one of the bound identifiers deterministically resolves to an immutable typed effect request and that the canonical authority evidence plus executor input both bind the same request digest before dispatch.
required_successor_contract: bind a canonical typed effect-request identity or request_sha256 into the pre-authority intent
make canonical authority evidence echo/bind that exact semantic request identity
make the dispatch/executor boundary consume or verify the same request identity
include effect policy inputs required by the admitted EffectGate without trusting model-authored classification
reject semantic-request mismatch before executor invocation
preserve UNKNOWN/no-replay behavior after any ambiguous post-dispatch failure

decision.reason: Current EntityOS authority names EffectGate+EffectJournal as the sole real-effect authority but does not bind that authority to one executable repository/commit/module/blob/journal-schema/adapter-API identity. In addition, the current F2 pre-authority ABI binds call correlation but not the semantic effect request that an EffectGate must authorize. Promoting a reference gate, a historical ClayVerse donor, or an unbound out-of-band request by inference would violate FACT_UNKNOWN + METHOD_PRESENT != FACT_PRESENT and could create or bypass effect authority.
decision.authority_counterhypothesis: The ClayVerse donor may still be the intended compatibility implementation despite its historical path/name.
decision.authority_falsifier: A newer current authority/manifest/receipt that explicitly binds EffectGate+EffectJournal to exact executable module bytes and journal schema/API would falsify the authority-identity part of this block.

admission_choices: explicitly re-admit the reviewed ClayVerse donor bytes as a compatibility implementation under current EntityOS authority
or bind a native EntityOS EffectGate/EffectJournal successor at exact identity
prohibited_shortcuts: F2 must not create its own independent canonical effect policy or journal authority merely to close WP105
F2 must not treat a correlation identifier as semantic effect authorization unless an exact immutable request-resolution binding is proven
an authorizer closure carrying action/target/capability out of band is not sufficient unless that semantic request is cryptographically/typed-bound to the intent, evidence and executor input

next_exact_action: Current EntityOS authority must emit or expose one explicit ENTITYOS_CANONICAL_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_BINDING/v1-equivalent record AND an exact typed semantic effect-request binding. The existing WP105 mutation authority can then extend/consume the production port so one immutable request identity is shared by authority evaluation, canonical PENDING effect_id creation and executor dispatch; execute the no-real-external-effect matrix: semantic request + call identity -> authority decision -> canonical PENDING effect_id before executor dispatch -> exact F2 call/request correlation -> VERIFIED or UNKNOWN journal transition -> completion promotion only from verified evidence, with UNKNOWN remaining non-replayable.
